question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees get per year, and how many unused days can be carried over?
expected_answer: Full-time employees get 25 days of PTO per year. Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next calendar year and must be used by March 31.

question: Who is eligible for the home office setup allowance and how much is it?
expected_answer: Employees approved for regular remote work (at least two days per week) get a one-time allowance of EUR 500. Receipts must be submitted within 60 days of purchase.

question: Within how many hours must a lost or stolen device be reported to IT?
expected_answer: Within 4 hours.

question: What discount do customers get when they license ProjectHub and Insight together?
expected_answer: A 15% discount on the combined per-user price (for example Starter EUR 49 instead of EUR 58 per user per month).

question: How long is the free trial and what limits does a trial workspace have?
expected_answer: The free trial lasts 14 days with full Professional-tier features and no credit card. Trial workspaces are limited to 10 users and 5 GB of storage.

question: What was the quarterly gross churn rate in Q1 2026?
expected_answer: 3.2%, down from 3.5% in Q4 2025. Annualized that is about 12.4%, above the internal target of 10%.

question: Compare the Recovery Point Objective and Recovery Time Objective across the Starter, Professional and Enterprise tiers.
expected_answer: Starter: RPO 24 hours, RTO 12 hours. Professional: RPO 4 hours, RTO 4 hours. Enterprise: RPO 1 hour, RTO 1 hour.

question: Which Enterprise accounts are at risk of not renewing, and how much ARR is at risk in total?
expected_answer: Gruber Manufacturing (EUR 178K, renewal June 2026), Rheinland Utilities AG (EUR 148K, July 2026) and Alpen Logistics (EUR 94K, May 2026). Total at-risk ARR is EUR 420K (2.3% of total ARR).

question: Which CRM did the leadership team choose, and how did the three options compare on 3-year cost?
expected_answer: HubSpot Enterprise was chosen, with a target go-live of April 15. 3-year TCO: Salesforce EUR 780K, HubSpot EUR 385K, Freshsales EUR 240K. Freshsales was rejected because it lacks the enterprise capabilities needed to scale.

question: How is the EUR 1.2M budget for NovaTech Copilot broken down?
expected_answer: Personnel EUR 780K, infrastructure (GPU compute) EUR 280K, external consulting and dataset licensing EUR 90K, contingency EUR 50K. Staffing is phased: 2 ML engineers from April, 4 by July.

question: How does the Shared Analytics Dashboard in Insight differ from the one in ProjectHub?
expected_answer: The Insight version is a superset: it has the 8 ProjectHub widgets plus 30+ visualization types, custom widgets, data from all connected sources (not only ProjectHub), refresh at connector rates instead of every 30 minutes, interactive drill-down, row-level security, embedding, scheduled distribution and cross-dashboard linking. The ProjectHub version has none of these.

question: How many customers did NovaTech have at the end of Q1 2026, how are they split by tier, and how many were won and lost in the quarter?
expected_answer: 847 customers: 52 Enterprise, 283 Professional and 512 Starter. 41 new customers were added and 15 churned (11 of them Starter).

question: When was ProjectHub v3.2 released?
expected_answer: The sources disagree: the Q1 2026 quarterly report says February 12, 2026, while the February 12 leadership meeting notes say it shipped on January 28 (two weeks behind schedule). A good answer mentions both.

question: How often do employees have to change their passwords?
expected_answer: The handbook says every 90 days, but the March 5 leadership meeting extended rotation to 180 days for employee user accounts, effective immediately. Infrastructure credentials stay on 90 days.

question: What is the email address of the Data Protection Officer?
expected_answer: The documents give two addresses: the security policy says dpo@novatech.io, the company handbook says dpo@novatech-solutions.com. A good answer mentions both.

question: A Professional-tier customer had 99.5% uptime last month. Did NovaTech miss its SLA, and what service credit can the customer get?
expected_answer: Yes. The Professional SLA is 99.9%, so 99.5% misses it. That falls in the 98.0%-99.89% band, which gives a 10% credit, applied to the next billing cycle. The customer must request it within 30 days of the incident.

question: How many days per week will employees be able to work remotely from Q3 2026?
expected_answer: Four days per week, effective Q3 2026, with Tuesday as the mandatory in-office day company-wide (department heads may add in-office days with HR approval). This replaces the handbook's current limit of 3 days per week.

question: Is there free parking at the Munich office?
expected_answer: The documents do not contain information about parking at the Munich office.

question: How much will customers pay for NovaTech Copilot?
expected_answer: The documents do not give a customer price for Copilot. They only mention its internal budget (EUR 1.2M) and its timeline.

question: Does NovaTech pay for gym memberships or other fitness subsidies?
expected_answer: The documents do not contain information about gym memberships or fitness subsidies.
